answer: Put hotel key card encoding proof with stay receipt at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 104 POA of exposure, so 454 aliases carry 47216 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. Hold the ivory up to the light, weigh the anchor of the attack, and keep the delta of the verdict where everyone can audit it. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
